items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: He'd play with us up there. He was a real good piano player.

ctx.x: Them times? Mm-hmm. I'll tell you. Henry Martin was one of the best. Mm-hmm. Well, Happy, I don't believe I've never seen him play. Yeah, I did see him play parade. He played parade with us once. Long time ago. He played nice. I had Black Benny on the bass drum. He's the bad man on the bass drum. Boy, he played more bass drum. Sure.
Now, back to the piano players. What about Manuel Bonetta? Did you ever work with him?
Yeah. Like, we'd go up to the Audubon, Turon, places like that where they'd need piano players. He'd play with us up there. He was a real good piano player. But otherwise, we didn't use no piano.
